parameter.name: netback_per_bbl
parameter.label: Value of a lost barrel (CAD per boe)

ds_p1_spend.sql: SELECT field_operating_area, SUM(repair_cost) AS repair_cost_12m FROM main.strathcona.gold_repair_cost_month WHERE month > add_months((SELECT MAX(month) FROM main.strathcona.gold_repair_cost_month), -12) GROUP BY field_operating_area

ds_p1_lost_oil.sql: SELECT field_operating_area, SUM(lost_oil_m3) AS downhole_lost_oil_m3_12m, SUM(lost_oil_m3) * 6.2898 * :netback_per_bbl AS downhole_lost_oil_value FROM main.strathcona.gold_loss_bucket_month WHERE downtime_bucket = 'Downhole' AND month > add_months((SELECT MAX(month) FROM main.strathcona.gold_loss_bucket_month), -12) GROUP BY field_operating_area

ds_p1_loss_month.sql: SELECT month, field_operating_area, downtime_bucket, SUM(lost_oil_m3) AS lost_oil_m3 FROM main.strathcona.gold_loss_bucket_month WHERE downtime_bucket NOT IN ('Economic') AND month >= DATE '2023-01-01' GROUP BY month, field_operating_area, downtime_bucket

ds_p1_repair_area.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT field_operating_area, job_category, SUM(repair_cost) AS repair_cost, SUM(jobs) AS jobs FROM main.strathcona.gold_repair_cost_month WHERE month >= DATE '2025-06-01' GROUP BY 1, 2), t AS (SELECT field_operating_area, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(repair_cost) DESC) AS rn FROM a GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN t.rn <= 8 THEN a.field_operating_area ELSE 'Other areas' END AS field_operating_area, a.job_category, SUM(a.repair_cost) AS repair_cost, SUM(a.jobs) AS jobs FROM a JOIN t USING (field_operating_area) GROUP BY 1, 2

ds_p1_type_share.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT failure_type, COUNT(*) AS failures, SUM(COALESCE(repair_cost, 0)) AS repair_cost FROM main.strathcona.gold_failure_gap WHERE failure_date >= DATE '2025-06-01' AND failure_type IN ('Rods', 'Pump', 'Tubing') GROUP BY failure_type) SELECT failure_type, failures / SUM(failures) OVER () AS share_of_failures, repair_cost / SUM(repair_cost) OVER () AS share_of_repair_cost FROM f

ds_p2_counters.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT failure_type, CASE WHEN days_to_next_failure <= 90 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS r90 FROM main.strathcona.gold_failure_gap WHERE failure_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2026-07-28') SELECT AVG(r90) AS refail_90d_all, AVG(CASE WHEN failure_type = 'Rods' THEN r90 END) AS refail_90d_rods, AVG(CASE WHEN failure_type IN ('Pump', 'Tubing') THEN r90 END) AS refail_90d_pump_tubing FROM e

ds_p2_refail_type.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT failure_type, CASE WHEN days_to_next_failure <= 30 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS r30, CASE WHEN days_to_next_failure <= 90 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS r90 FROM main.strathcona.gold_failure_gap WHERE failure_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2026-07-28' AND failure_type IN ('Rods', 'Pump', 'Tubing')) SELECT failure_type, COUNT(*) AS failures, AVG(r30) AS refail_30d, AVG(r90) AS refail_90d FROM e GROUP BY failure_type UNION ALL SELECT 'All three types', COUNT(*), AVG(r30), AVG(r90) FROM e

ds_p2_gap.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN days_to_next_failure <= 7 THEN 1 WHEN days_to_next_failure <= 14 THEN 2 WHEN days_to_next_failure <= 30 THEN 3 WHEN days_to_next_failure <= 60 THEN 4 WHEN days_to_next_failure <= 90 THEN 5 ELSE 6 END AS sort_order FROM main.strathcona.gold_failure_gap WHERE failure_date >= DATE '2025-06-01' AND days_to_next_failure IS NOT NULL) SELECT sort_order, elt(sort_order, '0-7 days', '8-14 days', '15-30 days', '31-60 days', '61-90 days', 'Over 90 days') AS days_to_next_failure, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM g GROUP BY sort_order

ds_p2_monthly.sql: SELECT date_trunc('MONTH', failure_date) AS month, field_operating_area, failure_type, COUNT(*) AS failures FROM main.strathcona.gold_failure_gap WHERE failure_date >= DATE '2025-06-01' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

ds_p2_tier.sql: SELECT tier, CASE tier WHEN '0' THEN 1 WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '2' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS sort_order, COUNT(*) AS well_snapshots, AVG(CASE WHEN failed_next_90d THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS p_fail_next_90d FROM main.strathcona.gold_recency_tier GROUP BY tier

ds_p2_chronic.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT uwi, COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.strathcona.gold_failure_gap WHERE failure_date >= DATE '2025-06-01' GROUP BY uwi), g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN n = 1 THEN 1 WHEN n = 2 THEN 2 WHEN n <= 4 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS sort_order, COUNT(*) AS wells, SUM(n) AS failures FROM w GROUP BY 1) SELECT sort_order, elt(sort_order, '1 failure', '2 failures', '3-4 failures', '5+ failures') AS failures_per_well, wells / SUM(wells) OVER () AS share_of_wells, failures / SUM(failures) OVER () AS share_of_failures FROM g

ds_p3_list.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT w.*, CASE WHEN failures_last_90d >= 3 THEN '3+' ELSE CAST(failures_last_90d AS STRING) END AS recency_tier, repair_cost_12m + downhole_lost_oil_m3_12m * 6.2898 * :netback_per_bbl AS cost_score, datediff((SELECT MAX(failure_date) FROM main.strathcona.gold_failure_gap), last_failure_date) AS days_since_last_failure FROM main.strathcona.gold_work_list w WHERE failures_last_90d >= 1) SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY failures_last_90d DESC, cost_score DESC) AS priority_rank, uwi, well_name, field_operating_area, facility_name, pump_make, recency_tier, failures_last_90d, last_failure_type AS failure_type, last_failure_date, days_since_last_failure, repair_cost_12m, downhole_lost_oil_m3_12m, cost_score, surface_latitude, surface_longitude, CASE WHEN failures_last_90d >= 3 THEN 'Root-cause review before the next pull' WHEN failures_last_90d = 2 AND last_failure_type = 'Rods' THEN 'Review rod string and inhibition at the next pull' WHEN last_failure_type IN ('Pump', 'Tubing') THEN 'Check pump selection and tubing condition' ELSE 'Watch: one more failure puts it on the watchlist' END AS suggested_action FROM base

ds_p3_watch.sql: SELECT field_operating_area, uwi, repair_cost_12m FROM main.strathcona.gold_work_list WHERE failures_last_90d >= 2

ds_p3_watch3.sql: SELECT field_operating_area, uwi FROM main.strathcona.gold_work_list WHERE failures_last_90d >= 3

ds_p4_actions.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT * FROM main.strathcona.gold_payback_grid WHERE netback_mult = 1 AND action_cost_mult = 1) SELECT action, MAX(eligible_wells) AS eligible_wells, MAX(failures_per_well_year) AS observed_failures_per_well_year, MAX(cost_per_failure) AS cost_per_failure, MAX(action_cost_per_well) / MAX(cost_per_failure) AS break_even_failures_avoided_per_well, SUM(CASE WHEN avoided_share = 0.25 THEN eligible_wells * (failures_per_well_year * avoided_share * cost_per_failure - action_cost_per_well) END) AS net_benefit_if_25pct, SUM(CASE WHEN avoided_share = 0.5 THEN eligible_wells * (failures_per_well_year * avoided_share * cost_per_failure - action_cost_per_well) END) AS net_benefit_if_50pct, MAX(CASE WHEN avoided_share = 0.25 THEN 12 * action_cost_per_well / (failures_per_well_year * avoided_share * cost_per_failure) END) AS payback_months_if_25pct, MAX(CASE WHEN avoided_share = 0.5 THEN 12 * action_cost_per_well / (failures_per_well_year * avoided_share * cost_per_failure) END) AS payback_months_if_50pct FROM b GROUP BY action

ds_p4_grid.sql: SELECT action, netback_mult, action_cost_mult, avoided_share, eligible_wells * (failures_per_well_year * avoided_share * cost_per_failure - action_cost_per_well) AS net_benefit FROM main.strathcona.gold_payback_grid

ds_p4_budget.sql: SELECT scenario, wells_treated, total_action_cost, savings_low, savings_high, savings_low - total_action_cost AS net_low, savings_high - total_action_cost AS net_high FROM main.strathcona.gold_budget_scenarios ORDER BY wells_treated

ds_p5_kpi.sql: SELECT capture_10, capture_10 / 0.10 AS lift_vs_random, size_capture_10 / 0.10 AS size_lift, concat(format_number(ci_low * 100, 1), '% to ', format_number(ci_high * 100, 1), '%') AS interval_95 FROM main.strathcona.gold_validation_summary

ds_p5_curve.sql: SELECT share_targeted, ranking, share_captured FROM main.strathcona.gold_validation_curve

ds_p5_warning.sql: SELECT rule_name, is_baseline, 'Precision' AS measure, precision AS value FROM main.strathcona.gold_warning_eval UNION ALL SELECT rule_name, is_baseline, 'Recall', recall FROM main.strathcona.gold_warning_eval

ds_p6_clean.sql: SELECT rule, table_name, rows_affected, rows_affected / table_rows AS share_of_table FROM main.strathcona.cleaning_log WHERE rows_affected > 0 ORDER BY rows_affected DESC

ds_p6_rank_change.sql: SELECT 50 - SUM(CASE WHEN rank_clean <= 50 AND rank_raw <= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wells_that_change FROM main.strathcona.gold_cleaning_impact WHERE rank_clean <= 50 OR rank_raw <= 50

Repair cost uses field estimates, not invoices.
Action cost is assumed from the Workover median because no regional price was found.
Avoided shares of 25% and 50% are assumptions; action effects are associations, not proven causes.
